title: 5 free tools for Claude Code (engine test)
voiceLabel: পরীক্ষার ভয়েস: Kokoro am_michael, ১.৩৫ গুণ গতি
goal: ইঞ্জিনের পরীক্ষা: পাঁচটা ছাঁচ (fix, hub, pipeline, trace, dial) একটা ভিডিওতে ঠিকমতো চলে কিনা।

hook.line: Don't build with Claude Code until you've installed these five free tools.

tools.name: Context7
tools.intro: The first is Context7, from Upstash.
tools.body: It pulls the current docs for any library you use, so Claude stops writing code that broke two versions ago. Fresh docs, every time.

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.body: It lets Claude read any website, docs, blogs and pricing pages as clean text, so research takes seconds, not hours.

tools.name: GitHub MCP
tools.intro: The third is the GitHub MCP server.
tools.body: It lets Claude open issues, write the fix, review the pull request and merge it, so one prompt ships the whole change.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.intro: The fourth is Playwright MCP, from Microsoft.
tools.body: It clicks through your login, checkout and search like a real user, so every flow is tested before you ship.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.maker: from the Chrome team at Google
tools.intro: And the fifth is Chrome DevTools MCP, from the Chrome team at Google.
tools.body: It opens your app in a real Chrome, reads the red errors in the console and fixes them itself.

cta.line: Comment TOOLS, and I'll send you one link with all five.
